title: Multi Hook Wall Mount Rack 6-Hook Solid Brass 15.5-Inch | Glokzin Teal | Brass Multi Hooks | Allied Brass
description:
Stop piling towels, robes, and belts on the counter—this wall-mount multi hook creates an organized, easy-to-grab storage zone in your bathroom in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms.

Highlights:
- Glokzin Teal transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 100 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Bring a balanced, transitional touch to your space with the distinctive Brass Multi Hooks collection design
- Count on enduring construction crafted from solid brass materials
- Coordinate with your bathroom hardware thanks to multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: 6-position multi hook wall rack
- Material: Solid brass
- Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting hardware included
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 15.5 x 3.2 x 4 inches
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 12 x 6 x 4 inches
- Shipping weight: 3 lbs
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
